content: Yal Yudas Yisas bai tal sire singaba hobi teralua dungwo ha
Ena homa God Isrel ari hobi wang homini si gonamba, han uning si tomia dire, homena si gal nere, God wai pir tere, erin mongwo haung u mala ungure hon nomani si pungwi.
Pirere ha maing oo singaba ire, Lo ana holo holo ha nir si tongwo hobi ire dire, Yisas si golala dire, ha hole hol wa dungwi. Dumba, ari para weni Yisas pir tomia dire, han uning sire ya mongwi.
Ena Yisas grang wine ongwo ari ana holo holo kebena sutani yalhobi mongwo sina i, yal ta Yudas Iskeriot mongwo bani, Seten ure yong wu bungwi.
Bungure yal i ha maing oo singaba ire, ha maing plisman ire dire, mongwo bani u pa dire, Yisas han holala dire ha di tibi olungwi.
Olungure yal hobi wai pire, “Owa ni yu onanga moni tobo ni teralua”.
Ditongure yal Yudas, “Para dinia, han molo,” ditere, ari ta hon ekinangwo gin i na Yisas bai tal siralga irawa dire, kwi han mongwi.
Yon Pita kina erin homena akun onama dire nu si olungwo ha
Ena erin habang iwe, kun sipi sipi giring si ke nongwo haung u tibi ungwi.
Ungure Yisas Pita Yon kina nu si olere, “Ni yasuri pire erin homena akun ol engere nenamna po,” ditongwi.
“Oo makena akun ol enamne?”
Ditongure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Piro. Ni yasuri pi oo malgi pa dinanba, yal ta nir mugu hol ire unangwo hanania.
Hananga yal i, oo ala ta nangwo i doling bol i pire, oo hong yal i yu ditenania, Tisa yu dimia piro. Ni oo weran ta na tengere, erin homena nenamna i tibi olo, dungure uminua.
Dinangere oo hong yal i weran ta mini bani i tibi ol ni tenamia. Tenangure, ni yasuri pire bol homena akun ole eyo.”
Dungure yasuri pire, oo hong yal i ha dungwo meri boling kul tomia, oo weran ta tongure, homena akun ole mongwi.
Yisas gamahobi breti wain kina tongwo ha
Ena haung mala weni ongure, pudungwo Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina homena bol bani ami di mongwi.
Mongure yalhobi yu ditongwi, “Na gauna gul bir iralga mala umba, homa ni yalhobi kina erin homena i nerala dire wai pirige.
Emgi erin homena i hon nekire moli ogere, God kene ongwo bani u tibi ure nima pire pai monangwo gin i, erin homena hon yulang bonangure hon nenaminua.”
Yu dire mulu hau are “God ni nir na tenga wai piriwa,” dire yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi nir i ebil sire ari hobi to.
Emgi nir i hon ta nekire moli ogere, God kene ongwo bani u tibi ure nima pire pai monangwo gin i, nir i hon nenaminua.”

Yu dire homena breti ire, “God ni homena na tenga wai piriwa” dire, du dire yalhobi tongwi. Tere yu ditongwi, “Iwe, na yulana dimia. (Na yulana ni yalhobi miling pule ni teralia. Na pir na tere nere nere molio.”
Yu dire homena ne wai sungure, mulu hau nir holere tere yu ditongwi, “Mulu hau nir iwe, nomani hon gwa si ni teiya. Tegere God bolo guman puli ire u tani nana dire, na nan algi u mena namua.”)
“Hanega. Nan yalhobi homena tani nere ha wai dire mominga hobi, ta na bai tal sinania.
Ena God Ari Wang Weni gonama di pungwo meri, na golalga pamua. Pamiba na bai tal sinangwo yal i, miling pirie. Gaung gul obilga inama di pino? Bir weni inangwo pamua.”
Dungure yalhobi nin di wama tere, “Ara onama dire dime?” di mongwi.
Yisas gamahobi ara singaba monamine dire bolbin dungwo ha
Ena grang wine ongwo hobi molere, “Nan yal ara singaba molere, kene onamne?” dire bolbin dungwi.
Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ari singaba king ta molere, hamil ha sire honagi ha dungwo te kene ol tongwo hobi yal i na yahuna ta moma di pimia.
Pimba, ni yalhobi monga sina i yal ta yal bir molala di pinangiwe, yal kultaing mongwo meri monania. Te singaba molala di pinanga, nir honagi oli nanga pire singaba monanua.

Yal ta nir hole yal ta tongwo nomia. Nongwo yal i singaba mom mo, te nir hongwo yal i singaba mome?” Dungure, yalhobi “Nir nongwo yal i singaba momua,” ditongwi. Ditomba, Yisas yu ditongwi, “Na nir honagi yal moliwa.
Na gauna gul ire moli ogiwe, ni yalhobi na pia si nin bangi olekingere, ereho moli uminia.
Moli uminga Nabe ai ta na tongwo kene ol molalga meri, na ere ni yalhobi ai ta ni teralga kene yu ol monanua. Na kene olga bani iwe, nir nere homena nere monaminua.
Molere Isrel wiyol ana holo holo kebena sutani hobi para weni bring aholo sire kene ol monanua.
Yisas Pita mobeng hal wa na tenanua dungwo ha

“Ena Saimon, ni piro. Seten God sirin bol pimia. Pire urere, ni kela kul ni terala dire unamia. Yal ta hopi miling pere masin ongwo meri iwe, Seten ure kraun siralga pir na tenana dire yu ol ni tenamia. Tenamba miling dungwo meri ha maing a i si wananga nimni monanua.

Yu onamiba, na haya God Saimon aki di tenanga, Saimon nimni monamua di te pisole moliwa. Te ni mobin hal wa na tenangiwe, tere enin tau mobin hal wa na tenamba, ni hon aki di tenangere, hon nimni mole na pir na tenamua.”
Dungure Pita yu ditongwi, “Yal Yisas ye, ni halabusi pananga mo, gonanga, na kina ereho golabila dire, ni kwi han moliwa.”
Dimba Yisas Pita yu ditongwi, “Kenba ginangwo ni homa gin sui tai dire na hana di kul sinangere, emgi hoale be dinamua,” dungwi.
Moni gal blasben di baina tal su hobi ha

Ena yu dire Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Homa na ni ha maing honagi onana dire, ni bai nu si olga onga irawe, moni gal kebin to, blasben ta ire honirayo, onga gin iwe, pi mole mena gole banta paikin mo?” dungwi. “Mena ta golkiminua,” dungwi.

“Yu oniba, omaga iwe, yal ta moni gal giranga meri kene ole ire nanga pamua. Te gal blasben ere para kine ire nanga pamua. Te di baina ta hol sikinanga, gal yal ta tere moni inangiwe, di baina hon bring sire a ire po.

Ha maing buku awa ha yu pamiraya, ha hol ole halabusi pai mongwo hobi, yal i kina ereho si daule monamua. ( Ais 53:12) Ha di engwo iwe, omaga na molga bani nima namua. Te homa na pire awa ha di engwiwe, nima pire pai omua,” dungwi.
Dungure yalhobi yu ditongwi, “Yal Yisas ye, na yalhobi di baina sutani dimia hanega,” dungwi. “Owa, i para dimua,” dungwi.
Yisas irang God ha di terala dire Getsemani ongwo ha
Ena Yisas girungwo haung haung ongwo meri Yerusalem aidolere, ere Olibi hamen hul ongure, yalhobi doling bol ongwi.
Pi pa dire Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi monga bani tal nigi dongwo onanga pamua. Pamba, God gala dinangere, ni aki di ni tenangure, nimni mole monanua.”
Dire obilga ulubi pire, ikwi bole God yu ditongwi, “Nabe, ni aki di na terala di pinanga, aki di na to.
Tenanga, omaga gul iralga haung u tibi ta hunama di piriwa. Piriba, na hana ta paikima, ni nin hani pamia. Dinanga meri na wine olalua.”
(Yu dungure hamen bani ensel ta ya ime ure, aki di tongwi.
Tomba, Yisas yong sina hoho mo ure erin bai tabilungure, ha hon erakere ditongwi. Dite mongwo bani, pir pan iwe, ari algi yangwo meri ya ganba bani sungwi.)
Di te pisolere, aire ere grang wine ongwo hobi mongwo bani ongwi. Pi hangure yalhobi Yisas tal ta ol tenangwo miling gul sungure, pole pole ul pai mongwo hangwi.

Hanere yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi talongwo ul pane? Aire hon mole God ha di te molkino? Ul panangiwe, Seten ni kraun sire kela kul ni tenangwo ni bol yanana dire yu onamia. Aire hon mole God ha di tere tere molo.
Yudas Yisas bai tal sire kiang hobi tongwo ha
Yu dire mongure, Yisas kiang gintani u pa dungwi. Dire grang wine ongwo yal Yudas homa ere, Yisas gumang mu dirala dire ungwi.
Umba, Yisas yu ditongwi, “Yal Yudas, Ari Wang Weni na ni gumana mu dinia. Talongwo mu dire na bai tal sine?”
Ena grang wine ongwo hobi Yisas tal ol terala dire ongwo hanere, yu dungwi, “Yal Yisas ye, na yalhobi tau di sinamne?”
Dire grang wine ongwo yal ta di baina aki dire sungure, ha maing oo singaba honagi yal ta kraung weni hol i bol wal kungwi.
Kungure Yisas hanere yu dungwi, “A, onga paikimia, hon olkio,” dire, kraung hon adagi si e tongwi.

Ena Yisas inaa dire, ha maing oo singaba ire, ha maing oo plisman ire, ha maing oo kene ongwo hobi ire dire, han hol irala dire ungwo yalhobi yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi na na han sirala dire unia. Ungiwe, di baina ire, di sire ire ure, yal ta homena kuni nongwo han sirala dire un mo?

Ya monga haung iwe, nan yalhobi kinbe kinbe ha maing oo ala molere, ha nir si ni tega pir mongarai, na han holkingirawe. Holkiniraba, ni yalhobi nin pinga haung, te si bongwo yulang tongwo hobi para pungwo haung, omaga werigi dimua,” dungwi.
Pita Yisas na hankiwa di kirulu dungwo ha
Ena yalhobi Yisas han holere aule irere, Yuda ha maing oo singaba ke pangwo malgi ongwi. Ongure yal Pita pirere, naa di mongwi.
Malgi sina iwe, endo gale pir mongure, Pita para pi endo pire ami di mongwi.
Mongure honagi ama ta ure, tene han mole yu dungwi, “Yal i Yisas kina ereho wangwo haniga irawe.”
Dimba, Pita ha di kul sire, “Alhuno, na yal i ta hankiwa” dungwi.
Yu di tere olo mol gobari hongure, yal ta ure yu dungwi, “Ni yal i gamahobo weni kara monga irawe.” Dimba, Pita yu ditongwi, “Ayo, na yal i gamahobo ta molkimna, pisolimo.”
Ena emgi yal ta u pa dire, yulang bole yu dungwi, “A i haweni kara dimia. Yal i Galili hong yal momia. Yisas kina ereho mole wamua.”
Dimba Pita yu dungwi, “Haniraba dinga pir kun olekiwe.” Yu di mongure, hoale gintani be dungwi.

Dungure yal Yisas inaa dire, Pita tene han tongwi. Tongure Pita Yisas ha homa ditongwo irai, hon i kraung bani ere nomani si pungwi, “Girungwo ni homa gin sui tai dire na hana di kul sinangere, emgi hoale be dinamua,” ditomiraya, hon nomani si pirere,
ere mena pire, similo hai me mongwi.
Ari hobi Yisas gaung ha sire sungwo ha
Ena plisman Yisas kene ongwo hobi Yisas gaung ha sire kuba sungwi.
Sire omeling apalapo ire to si tere yu ditongwi, “Ni sungwo yal i haang arawe?”
Dire ha yong miki i tongwi.
Kiang hobi Yisas aule ire Kaunsil mongwo bani pire ha hol ol tongwo ha
Ena honmil hamen tangure Yuda ari singaba hobi ire, kene ongwo hobi ire, Lo ana holo holo tisa ire dire, u ku bol mongwi.
Mongure Yisas aule ire kaunsil mongwo bani ongwi. Ongure yalhobi yu ditongwi, “Ni singaba Kraist mon mo, domo.” Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi na ha diga gin i, yol e pirikinia, talwa dirale?
Na sirin bol ni tenaminba, ni yalhobi sime molo di na tenania.
Ena omaga emgi na Ari Wang Weni molia. Molere yulang hong yal God kina kene ol molabilua.”
Dungure yalhobi yu ditongwi, “Ni God wang weni molia di pino?” Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi nin pinga meri dinua.”
Dungure yalhobi yu dungwi, “Nan tal ha hon dinangwo pinamne? Yali grang bani ha para di mena olungwo piminua,” dungwi.
